meta.name: planning-with-files
meta.description: Manus-style persistent file-based planning for AI coding agents: keeps task_plan.md, findings.md, and progress.md on disk so work survives context loss and /clear. Use when asked to plan out, break down, or organize a multi-step project, research task, or any work requiring 5+ tool calls. Supports automatic session recovery after /clear.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用文件持久化任务计划，避免上下文丢失
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要规划多步任务并担心上下文丢失
copy.tagline_en: Persist task plans to files, survive context loss
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often plan multi-step tasks and worry about losing context

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会在磁盘上维护 task_plan.md、findings.md 和 progress.md 三个文件，作为持久化工作记忆。每次对话开始或 /clear 后，它会自动恢复之前的计划、发现和进度，避免上下文丢失。
howto.when: 当你要求规划、分解或组织一个多步骤项目、研究任务，或任何需要 5 次以上工具调用的工作时触发。也支持在 /clear 后自动恢复会话。

say.text: 帮我规划一个多步骤项目，创建 task_plan.md。
say.note: Claude 会创建计划文件并开始执行。

say.text: 更新 progress.md，记录我刚才完成的工作。
读取 findings.md，看看之前发现了什么。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude maintains task_plan.md, findings.md, and progress.md on disk as persistent working memory. It automatically recovers previous plans, findings, and progress after session start or /clear, preventing context loss.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to plan, break down, or organize a multi-step project, research task, or any work requiring 5+ tool calls. Also supports automatic session recovery after /clear.

say_en.text: Plan a multi-step project and create task_plan.md.
say_en.note: Claude creates the plan file and starts executing.

say_en.text: Update progress.md with what I just did.
Read findings.md to see previous discoveries.
